{{nihongo|'''Nomi Shrine'''|野見神社 (一宮市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Owari Province]].

=== Enshrined deities ===
* {{ill|Nomi no Sukune|de|Nomi-no-Sukune|fa|نومی نو سوکونه|ff|Nomi no Sukune|fr|Nomi-no-Sukune|ja|野見宿禰|ru|Номи-но Сукунэ|uk|Номі-но-Сукуне|zh|野見宿禰|qid=Q965742|lt=Nomi no Sukune-no-Mikoto}}
* {{ill|Ame no Hohi|bg|Аме Но Хохи|fa|آمه-نو-هوهی|fr|Ame no Hohi|it|Ame no Hohi|ja|アメノホヒ|pl|Niebiański Duch Przewodni|ru|Амэ но Хохи|simple|Ame no Hohi|zh|天菩比神|qid=Q10940685|lt=Ame-no-Hohi-no-Mikoto}}
* {{ill|Amaterasu|abstract|Q455602|ar|أماتيراسو|ary|أماطيراسو|az|Amaterasu|bcl|Amaterasu|be|Аматэрасу|be_x_old|Аматэрасу|bew|Amatérasu|bg|Аматерасу|ca|Amaterasu|cs|Amaterasu|da|Amaterasu|de|Amaterasu|el|Αματεράσου|eo|Amaterasu|es|Amaterasu|et|Amaterasu|eu|Amaterasu|fa|آماتراسو|fi|Amaterasu|fr|Amaterasu|gl|Amaterasu|he|אמטראסו|hi|अमातेरसु|hr|Amaterasu|hu|Amateraszu Ómikami|hy|Ամատերասու Օմիկամի|id|Amaterasu|it|Amaterasu|ja|天照大神|jv|Amaterasu|ka|ამატერასუ|ko|아마테라스 오미카미|la|Amaterasu|lb|Amaterasu|lt|Amaterasu|lv|Amaterasu|min|Amaterasu|ml|അമതേരസു|mni|ꯑꯃꯇꯦꯔꯁꯨ ꯑꯣꯃꯤꯀꯃꯤ|ms|Amaterasu|nl|Amaterasu|nn|Amaterasu|no|Amaterasu|or|ଆମାତେରାଶୁ|pa|ਆਮਾਤੇਰਸ|pl|Amaterasu|pt|Amaterasu|ro|Amaterasu|rsk|Аматерасу|ru|Аматэрасу|sco|Amaterasu|sh|Amaterasu|simple|Amaterasu Ōmikami|sk|Amaterasu Ómikami|sl|Amaterasu|sr|Аматерасу|su|Amaterasu|sv|Amaterasu|ta|அமதெரசு|th|อามาเตราซุ|tl|Amaterasu|tok|jan sewi suli Amatelasu|tr|Amaterasu|uk|Аматерасу|uz|Amaterasu|vi|Amaterasu|wuu|天照大神|zh|天照大神|zh_min_nan|Amaterasu|zh_yue|天照大神|qid=Q455602|lt=Amaterasu-Ōmikami}}
These three {{ill|deities|ja|柱 (曖昧さ回避)|qid=Q16283888|lt=deities}} are the main deities; {{ill|Ukanomitama|lt=Ukanomitama|Q3080728|qid=Q3080728|lt=Uka-no-Mitama-no-Mikoto}} and {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|abstract|Q272993|ar|سوسانو|azb|سوسانو|bcl|Susanoo|be|Сусанаа|bg|Сусаноо|ca|Susanoo|cs|Susanoo|da|Susa-no-o|de|Susanoo|el|Σουσάνoο|eo|Susanoo|es|Susanoo|eu|Susanoo|fa|سوسانو (خدا)|fi|Susanoo|fr|Susanoo|hr|Susano|hu|Szuszanoo|hy|Սուսանո|id|Susanoo|it|Susanoo|ja|スサノオ|ka|სუსანოო-ნო-მიკოტო|ko|스사노오|la|Susano'o|lb|Susanoo|mni|ꯁꯨꯁꯅꯨ-ꯅꯣ-ꯃꯤꯀꯣꯇꯣ|nl|Susanoo|pl|Susanoo|pt|Susanoo|ro|Susanoo|rsk|Сусано|ru|Сусаноо|simple|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|sl|Susanovo|sr|Сусаноо|su|Susanoo|sv|Susanoo|ta|சுசானவோ|th|ซูซาโนโอะ|tok|jan sewi Susano|tr|Susanoo|uk|Сусаноо|vi|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|zh|素戔嗚尊|zh_min_nan|Susanoo|qid=Q272993|lt=Susa-no-O-no-Mikoto}} are additionally enshrined.

From the shrine name “Nomi,” the common view is that the deity is either Nomi no Sukune-no-Mikoto (ancestral deity of the {{ill|Haji clan|ja|土師氏|zh|土師氏|qid=Q10927758}}) or Ame-no-Hohi-no-Mikoto. In the precinct is the '''Nomi Shrine Kofun''', part of the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Imaise Kofun group}}, where {{ill|Magatama|Q334232|qid=Q334232}} and {{ill|Haniwa|Q849376|qid=Q849376}} have been unearthed. This also supports that the Haji clan was deeply involved not only in producing {{ill|Earthenware|af|Erdeware|ar|فخاريات|bn|মৃৎপাত্র|ca|Pisa (ceràmica)|cs|Pórovina|da|Lertøj|de|Irdengut|dga|Laa Meɛraa|es|Loza|eu|Loza (materiala)|fa|سفال|fr|Terracotta (matériau)|frr|Pottjüch|gl|Louza|he|חרס|hu|Cserép|id|Tembikar tanah liat|it|Terracotta|ja|土器|ko|토기|li|Steigood|nds_nl|Diggelwark|nl|Aardewerk|no|Leirtøy|pnb|مٹی دے برتݨ|simple|Earthenware|sv|Lergods|ta|மண் பானை|th|เครื่องดินเผาเนื้อพรุน|tr|Toprak eşya|uk|Глиняний посуд|vi|Đồ đất nung|zh|土器|qid=Q1377111}} but also in building {{ill|Kofun|ca|Kofun|cs|Kofun|da|Kofun|de|Kofun|eo|Kofun|es|Kofun|fa|کوفون|fi|Kofun|fr|Kofun|he|קופון (רוגם)|hr|Kofun (grobnica)|it|Kofun|ja|古墳|ko|고훈|my|ခိုဖွန်း|pl|Kofun (kurhan)|pt|Kofun|ru|Кофун (захоронение)|simple|Kofun|th|โคฟุง|tr|Kofun|uk|Кофун|zh|古墳|qid=Q1141225}}.

=== History ===
Its founding date is unknown, but it is presumed to have been established when the Haji clan developed this region. In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} it is listed as a {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=kokuhei small shrine}}, and in the ''Owari-koku Jinmyōchō'' it is recorded as “Junior Third Rank, Nomi Tenjin.” In the 6th year of {{ill|Ōei|Q1193078|qid=Q1193078}} ({{ill|1399|Q6422|qid=Q6422}}), the “Owari Province kokuga unpaid-tax report” (in the ''{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Daigoji documents}}'') mentions “Nomi-sha,” leading to the view that it held {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=shrine lands}} within the {{ill|Kokugaryō|Q11421344|qid=Q11421344|lt=kokuga territory}} at the time<ref name="一宮市史">''Newly Compiled History of Ichinomiya City, Main Text Upper Volume'', Ichinomiya City, 1977.</ref>. There is also a theory that the district name “Miyaushiro” means a settlement north of this shrine (Tsuda Masao, ''Study of Owari Place Names'').

=== Cultural properties ===
* {{ill|Castanopsis sieboldii|Q846994|qid=Q846994}} - Trunk circumference 2.5 m and height 20 m; a rare giant of its species with vigorous growth, designated a {{ill|Natural monument|Q23790|qid=Q23790}} of Ichinomiya.
*Nomi Shrine Kofun - A small {{ill|Round Kofun|ja|円墳|simple|Round Kofun|zh|圓墳|qid=Q11394747}} about 20 m long and 1 m high, thought to date to early period III of the {{ill|Kofun period|Q459939|qid=Q459939}} (first half of the 5th century)<ref name="一宮市史"/>. The Imaise Kofun group containing this tumulus is designated a city {{ill|Historic site|Q1081138|qid=Q1081138}}.

=== Access ===
*15 minutes on foot from {{ill|Imaise Station|Q6002985|qid=Q6002985}} on the {{ill|Meitetsu Nagoya Main Line|Q1137838|qid=Q1137838}} of {{ill|Meitetsu|Q30850|qid=Q30850}}
